findings.claim: Only deterministic local input defects and an exact Storage missing-object result enter terminal row-failure persistence.
evidence: The processor calls terminalRowFailureResponse only for absent verification_photo, an invalid owned object path, an exact missing-object classification, or locally rejected canonical image bytes.

isMissingReviewVerificationObject accepts only Supabase Storage 404/NoSuchKey shapes. A 403 or transport exception returns no row-failure code and falls through to OCR_READBACK_FAILED/OCR_PROCESSING_FAILED without terminal persistence.
Missing credentials return OCR_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE 503. Provider, quota, transport, durable-result, and persistence exceptions do not call persistAdminReceiptRowFailure.

findings.claim: Terminal failure persistence cannot overwrite an administrator photo replacement, owner change, or OCR snapshot change.
evidence: The update CAS binds id, user_id, null ocr_processed_at, verification_photo, receipt_hash, exact JSON receipt_data, and is_duplicate from the selected snapshot.

The independent readback accepts the requested failure only when owner, photo, cleared hash, duplicate flag, exact failure object, and processed timestamp match. A concurrent processed/failed winner is preserved; a changed nonterminal photo fails closed.

findings.claim: The workflow does not process a later row without terminal readback for the current row, and a confirmed terminal defect no longer starves the next selection.
evidence: persistAdminReceiptRowFailure performs an independent row read after the mutation and throws unless a processed/failed terminal row is observed.

runAdminReceiptOcrBatch performs another post-call read. A nonterminal 4xx/5xx increments failed and stops; a lost response/read increments indeterminate and stops. Only a terminal readback advances the loop.
The two-selection fixture first terminalizes the defective oldest row, then selects and processes the next pending row; a third selection is empty.

findings.claim: After an operator replaces the verification photo, the existing guarded rerun can reset the terminal OCR snapshot without overwriting that photo.
conditions: The rerun reads the current row and requires a current verification_photo.
Guarded confirmation, readiness, workflow configuration, and workflow preflight must pass.
The OCR reset CAS binds the current OCR snapshot and updates only OCR result fields; verification_photo is not written.

limitations: This is source-bound local verification. It does not prove hosted database trigger state, Storage behavior, provider/quota behavior, GitHub workflow delivery, deployment, or production execution.
The guarded-rerun evidence combines the isolated exact-CAS test with route source assertions; no external workflow dispatch was attempted.
The existing external Deep Research stages remain outside this independent read-only review.
